title: Customer recovery playbook
body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Risk tiers: Green (no validated concern), Yellow (emerging signal), Orange (multiple material unresolved signals), Red (severe validated business risk confirmed by CX leadership). Do not classify Red solely from renewal proximity. Recovery workflow: CSM validates signals, confirms ownership, agrees measurable milestones with the customer, and conducts weekly reviews. Proposed actions must be marked as proposals. Missing information lowers confidence. Recovery requires sustained customer outcomes and verified reliability, not just closing a ticket or reaching renewal. Cite source evidence and distinguish customer statements from model inference.
